biggest_catch: The $300 bonus requires holding an average daily balance of $1,000–$4,999.99 every day from day 31 to day 90 AND routing $500+ in employer or government direct deposits — and the bonus can be clawed back if you close within 12 months.
catches: You must be a new customer — not currently or previously an Associated Bank checking customer — and must open and fund the account by September 30, 2026.
Within 90 days of opening, at least $500 in recurring employer or government direct deposits must post — P2P payments, bank-to-bank transfers, and wires do not count.
From day 31 to day 90, the account must hold an average daily balance of $1,000–$4,999.99 to land the $300 tier ($5,000–$9,999.99 earns $400; $10,000+ earns $600).
The bonus is paid within 120 days of meeting the requirements — not immediately.
If you close the account within 12 months of opening, the bonus can be clawed back.
Online account opening is only available in IA, IL, IN, KS, MI, MN, MO, OH, and WI; other states must open in a branch.
Only one bonus per household; the bonus is taxable income (1099).

steps: Go to the official Associated Bank offer page https://www.associatedbank.com/checking-account-bonus-offer-promotion and confirm the offer is still showing before you apply.
Open a new eligible personal checking account and fund it by September 30, 2026 — online if you live in IA, IL, IN, KS, MI, MN, MO, OH, or WI, otherwise in a branch.
Within 90 days of opening, route at least $500 in recurring direct deposits from your employer or a government benefits provider — P2P payments and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
From day 31 through day 90 after opening, keep an average daily balance of $1,000–$4,999.99 in the account to land the $300 tier.
Keep the account open; the $300 bonus is paid within 120 days of meeting all requirements.
Keep the account open for a full 12 months — closing earlier can trigger a clawback of the bonus.
timing: Bonus paid within 120 days of meeting all requirements.
